title: Intelligent electric vehicles and embodied intelligence — research concept
purpose: A conceptual visual illustrating the group's research directions, not a photograph of its facilities or equipment.
processing: Original generated PNG copied into the workspace; JPEG export for web delivery. No generative edits or cropping.
prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural.
Asset type: a single finished hero photograph for the bilingual academic website “zhang’s group”, focused on intelligent electric vehicles and embodied intelligence. Generate a NEW image, not a screenshot or website mockup. Landscape composition, approximately 4:3.
Primary request: create a quiet, convincing, carefully composed editorial photograph of an intelligent electric vehicle and an embodied robotics research platform sharing one real-looking university engineering test hall. The image should have the restraint and tactile authenticity of an architectural magazine photograph, not a glossy AI concept render.
Scene: a modest, spacious modern engineering lab with pale concrete floor, a few subtle test lane markings, muted blue-gray walls, and large high windows providing soft overcast daylight. Uncluttered and plausible, not a futuristic spaceship or a car factory. A little real wear on floor and tools. No people.
Subjects: on the left/middle distance, a clean unbranded silver-white compact electric research vehicle, front three-quarter view, all four wheels in physically coherent positions, small realistic roof-mounted lidar and two modest sensor units, natural body panels and restrained headlights switched off. Keep the complete vehicle in frame. On the right/foreground, a compact mobile manipulation research robot with a low four-wheel rectangular base, one mechanically plausible articulated arm, a simple parallel two-finger gripper, and a small RGB-D camera; the gripper is manipulating one plain machined block on a waist-height workbench beside it. Distinct and physically connected arm joints, believable scale relative to the car. The vehicle and the robot are separate working platforms in the same research space, not a robotic arm repairing the car.
Composition: an intentional unified scene, not a diptych or collage. Camera at about 1.3m height with a natural 40mm editorial lens, moderate depth of field, straight architectural verticals, plenty of breathing room around both subjects. The entire vehicle is readable and the robot remains a clear second focal point at website thumbnail scale. Both subjects must fit within the central 88% of the frame. Upper quarter contains calm architectural background, minimal clutter. No text space needed because all captions will be added in HTML.
Lighting and palette: soft directional daylight, cool neutral steel blue, pearl white, graphite and warm-gray concrete, subtle natural reflections, modest contrast and subdued saturation. Visually harmonize with a deep navy university website, while keeping subjects light and clear. Do not make it gloomy.
Materials: matte powder-coated metal, lightly brushed aluminum, real rubber tires, faintly imperfect floor, glass with controlled reflections, subtle photographic grain. Real lens behavior, restrained sharpness. Make the scene feel observed rather than fabricated.
Text: none. No labels, no numbers, no logos, no watermark, no figure numbering, no charts.
Avoid: neon cyan or purple glows, holograms, floating interface graphics, flying particles, laser grids, sci-fi tunnels inside this image, exaggerated lens flares, plastic-looking materials, mirror floors, chrome everywhere, overly perfect CGI, cinematic orange/teal grading, cartoon style, concept-art painting, humanoid robots, extra robotic arms, distorted wheels, detached mechanical parts, charging-station stock-photo composition.
